name: Amazon SageMaker
overview: Amazon SageMaker provides managed tools/infrastructure to prepare data, build/train models, deploy endpoints and operate ML workflows.
examSignals: Build/train/deploy custom ML models and managed notebooks/pipelines: SageMaker
Use prebuilt NLP/vision API without model training: Comprehend/Rekognition/Textract

compareWith.diff: SageMaker is a broad managed ML platform for custom model workflows; Comprehend provides ready-made NLP APIs.
